clauses.source: forall c:Context: (forall a:AuthOccurrence: (QA(c,a) iff (AuthMember(c,a) and EvidenceRef(a)=RequestedEvidenceRef(c) and not (EvidenceRef(a)=empty) and not (SessionID(a)=empty) and Trusted(a))))

forall c:Context: (forall r:RouteOccurrence: (QR(c,r) iff (RouteMember(c,r) and RouteID(r)=RequestedRouteID(c) and not (RouteID(r)=empty) and not (ScopeEvidenceRef(r)=empty) and Complete(r) and not (PermissionResource(r)=empty) and not (PermissionAction(r)=empty) and not (PermissionScope(r)=empty))))

forall c:Context: (ReadyCondition(c) iff (not (RequestID(c)=empty) and (exists a:AuthOccurrence: (exists r:RouteOccurrence: (QA(c,a) and QR(c,r) and (forall a2:AuthOccurrence: (QA(c,a2) implies a2=a)) and (forall r2:RouteOccurrence: (QR(c,r2) implies r2=r)) and CandidateRequestID(c)=RequestID(c) and CandidateSessionID(c)=SessionID(a) and CandidateResource(c)=PermissionResource(r) and CandidateAction(c)=PermissionAction(r) and CandidateScope(c)=PermissionScope(r) and CandidateScopeEvidenceRef(c)=ScopeEvidenceRef(r))))))
forall c:Context: ((Decision(c)=READY iff ReadyCondition(c)) and (Decision(c)=DENY iff not ReadyCondition(c)))

interpretation_obligations: Every Context represents one complete finite-list input; all such contexts are quantified without an outcome-dependent scope predicate.
AuthMember and RouteMember map every valid list position injectively to a distinct occurrence, preserve equal duplicate rows, and exclude ghosts and foreign positions.
Every field function is total, and its member values project the exact field from that same list position; nonmember values cannot qualify without membership.
Trusted and Complete mean exactly the corresponding true-valued source fields; empty is the exact empty string.
Decision maps only to the pure command-boundary result under separately checked normal-completion and source-correspondence assumptions.
claim_ceiling: Non-current formation design sketch only. Typed parsing and exact-source controls do not prove equivalence to the draft definitions, interpretation-model satisfaction, accepted v2 meaning, a current v4 FormalClaim, full no-downstream-call preservation, admission, TDE, F5, EVF or runtime_guarantees_observed.
